description: This file is a shell script used for controlling LED indicators on an embedded device running OpenWrt. It defines functions to set LED states based on device boot or operation status, and references external functions for LED control.

methods.name: set_led_state
methods.description: Sets the LED indicator state based on input parameter indicating current device status (e.g., preinit, failsafe, upgrade).

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Determines whether to update LED state based on current device status variables.
